96 
 
 
 
 
 
 Plus, money for making metals. | Tuesday, November 17, 2026 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 View in browser 
 
 
 
 
 
   
 
 
 Axios Pro Rata 
 
 
 
 
 By Dan Primack · Nov 17, 2026 
 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Top of the Morning 
 
 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Illustration: Axios Visuals

 
 
 
   
 
 We are just a few hours away from kickoff to Axios BFD , our annual dealmakers summit in New York City.

 I'm looking forward to seeing hundreds of you in person, and everyone can watch the livestream beginning at 2pm ET. The lineup Robert F. Smith , interviewed by Dan Primack 

 Robert is founder and CEO of Vista Equity Partners, one of the world's largest private equity firms dedicated to software and enterprise AI. This is a pivotal moment for tech investors — even beyond the Nvidia tumult and Anthropic IPO — as new models challenge proven playbooks. John C. Williams , interviewed by Neil Irwin 

 John is president and CEO of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, and is one of the central bank's leaders among equals. He's the Fed official most tied to financial markets, with a direct window into Wall Street. If the AI trade goes kaboom, the New York Fed would be on the front lines of tracking the damage, assessing threats to financial stability and responding to market disruptions. Tarek Mansour , interviewed by Madison Mills 

 Tarek is co-founder and CEO of Kalshi, the country's top prediction market. Its users got the midterms right, but the resulting Congress could create more scrutiny for a financial sector that has quickly gone from niche to ubiquitous. Alex Rodriguez , interviewed by Dan Primack 

 Alex is one of very few star athletes to go on to own pro sports teams, and our discussion comes as Major League Baseball is just weeks away from a possible lockout. He's currently co-owner of the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves, the WNBA's Minnesota Lynx, has investments in over 40 other companies and a giant real estate portfolio. He also once wanted to get traded to my beloved Boston Red Sox, so I'm okay with this. Lia Dean & Maria Sharapova , interviewed by Madison Mills 

 Lia is president of banking and premium products at Capital One, while Maria is a tennis legend and entrepreneur. They each have unique insights into the state of the consumer, at a time when "affordability" is the dominant economic buzzword. Chris Sacca , interviewed by Dan Primack 

 Chris is at the forefront of climate-tech investing via Lowercarbon Capital, the firm he founded after years of backing tech startups like Twitter, Uber, and Instagram. It's a sector that much of venture had forgotten — or avoided for political reasons — until data center energy demands became too big to ignore. Kim Posnett , interviewed by Dan Primack 

 Kim is global co-head of investment banking at Goldman Sachs, which means there is no one with a better sense of what's in market and what's coming next. Lessons from the SpaceX IPO, AI "bubble" talk, what CEOs want today from M&A, and much more. Joan Solotar , interviewed by Madison Mills 

 Joan is global head of private wealth at Blackstone, where she's leading the push to get individual investors into alternative investments — a move that the industry has long salivated over. Blackstone also happens to be one of the world's largest private equity and real estate investors, and a key player in the AI buildout. Omeed Malik & Donald Trump Jr. , interviewed by Dan Primack 

 Omeed is founder and president of 1789 Capital, while Don Jr. is his partner at 1789 and also executive vice president at The Trump Organization. 1789 has been on a heater, investing in companies like SpaceX, Anduril and Polymarket. But what does "patriotic capitalism" look like after a midterm election that saw voters revolt against data centers, particularly for a firm with a partner named Trump? Watch the livestream , beginning at 2pm ET. 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 The BFD 
 
 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Illustration: Megan Robinson/Axios

 
 
 
   
 
 General Flash, a Cambridge, Massachusetts-based startup that's developed a process for producing critical metals, has raised $128 million in seed and Series A funding led by Lux Capital and Overmatch Ventures .

 Why it's the BFD: America relies on foreign countries, including China, for the metallic building blocks of everything from phones to planes.

 Catch up quick: General Flash was launched last December by Ric Fulop, who previously founded lithium-ion battery pioneer A123 Systems and 3D printing company Desktop Metal.

 Early customers are expected to be government entities like DoD, although General Flash expects to eventually become dual-use. Other investors include Construct Capital, GreatPoint Ventures, Pillar VC, Lowercarbon Capital, Ensemble VC, and Ravelin.

 The bottom line: "This is a new way to make metals," says Fulop.

 "We've done things like this before. For example, there was a time when aluminum was more expensive than gold — the cap of the Washington Monument was made of aluminum because, at the time, it was a precious metal. Then we developed a new technique that made it less expensive." 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Venture Capital Deals 
 
 
   
 
 • Genesis AI , a general-purpose robotics startup, raised $500m in Series A funding at a $3.5b post-money valuation. Premji Invest , Khosla Ventures and Eclipse led, joined by Durable Capital Partners, T. Rowe Price, Bpifrance, HSG, Nvidia, AMD Ventures, Zoom, Samsung Next, Ericsson, Eric Schmidt, Eric Yuan, Jerry Yang, Xavier Niel, and Zach Kirkhorn. axios.link/4AvSVvI 

 🚑 Science , a med-tech startup whose lead product is a brain-computer interface, raised $400m in Series D funding from Khosla Ventures, Ackman Oxman Institute, Tenet Healthcare, 885 Capital, YC, and PLC Neurotech. axios.link/4ztRzAP 

 • Model ML , an automation platform for financial services, raised $250m in Series B funding at a $1.5b post-money valuation. General Atlantic and QED Investors led, joined by Evolution Equity Partners, Airtree, Forestay Capital, Y Combinator, FT Partners, Latitude, Inception Fund, and 13Books Capital. axios.link/4znCznO 

 🚑 Galvanize Therapeutics , a Redwood City, Calif.-based developer of pulsed electric field ablation for oncology and chronic disease, raised $130m in Series D funding. HealthQuest Capital led, joined by Olympus Innovation Ventures and Braidwell. axios.link/4iWXg3U 

 • Noeri , a developer of self-improving AI for enterprise, raised $110m. Menlo Ventures led, joined by Madrona Venture Group, Kindred Ventures, NEA, Nvidia, Snowflake, and Cisco Systems. axios.link/48VMbvl 

 🚑 Remedy Robotics , an SF-based endovascular robotics company, raised $62m in Series B funding. DCVC led, joined by UC Investments, Skip Capital, Hostplus, Build Collective, Blackbird, Divergent Capital, and KdT Ventures. axios.link/48VMdDt 

 • Compute Desk , an SF-based compute pricing startup, raised $45m in seed funding led by Lightspeed , per Axios Pro . axios.link/4AEUSpS 

 • Numa , an OS for car dealerships, raised $45m in Series C funding. Blue Cloud Ventures led, joined by Threshold Ventures, Costanoa, Touring Capital, Gradient Ventures, and Tokio Marine Future Fund. axios.link/4kT9jBU 

 • Promise Robotics , a Canadian physical AI startup focused on homebuilding, raised C$40m in Series B funding. White Star Capital led, joined by Horizons Ventures, Radical Ventures, and PSP Investments. promiserobotics.com 

 • Remanence , a French startup that helps businesses develop their own AI models via open weights, raised $30m in seed funding, per Axios Pro . EQT Ventures and FirstMark led, joined by Zero Prime, Emblem, Drysdale, Global Founders Capital, and Yellow. axios.link/4iUJtee 

 ⚡ Bedrock Energy , an Austin, Texas-based developer of drilling automation technology for on-site geothermal heating and cooling, raised $24m. Clean Energy Ventures and Clearvision Ventures led, joined by GVP Climate, Susquehanna Sustainable Investments, Temasek Trust, MUUS, Great Wave Ventures, Autodesk Foundation, and insiders Titanium Ventures, Energy Impact Partners, Wireframe Ventures, Elemental Impact, and SFV Capital. axios.link/4fB2Zvj 

 🚑 Aevius , a Boston-based patient intelligence platform, raised $22m in seed funding from Insight Partners , per Axios Pro . axios.link/4zm3O2b 

 • Arva AI , a maker of AI agents for banks' financial-crime compliance teams, raised $20m in Series A funding, per Axios Pro . Arthur Ventures led, joined by insiders Gradient and YC. axios.link/3UWec2r 

 • Valkryn , a Washington, D.C.-based auditor of defense-focused robotic and autonomous systems, raised $17m in seed funding. A16z led, joined by Ambition Capital, Caffeinated Capital, and Cantos Ventures. axios.link/4iMqfc3 

 • Islo , an NYC-based software development startup, raised $15m, per Axios Pro . Insight Partners led, joined by HIRO Capital. axios.link/4jmyWtG 

 🚑 Optain Health, an NYC-based retinal diagnostics startup, raised $13m from Morningside, Insight Partners, UniQuest Extension Fund, and undisclosed health systems. axios.link/48jquVZ 

 • Bevado , an NYC-based leasing and resident platform, raised $10m in seed funding. RET Ventures led, joined by Pear VC. axios.link/493vCO1 

 • Edra , an NYC-based enterprise workflow platform, raised $10m from EQT Ventures . axios.link/3XvlFX9 

 ⚡ Nomadic , a German maker of drones for monitoring power lines (while drawing power from them), raised $6m in seed funding. Foundamental led, joined by Verve Ventures, Cyan Ventures, Outlander VC, and Asia2G Capital. axios.link/48oBK3m 

 • Qluster , a French quantum computing startup, raised €4.7m in pre-seed funding. Quantonation led, joined by Quantum Launchpad and Bpifrance. axios.link/4fD1JI6 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Private Equity Deals 
 
 
   
 
 • Apollo will invest $2.5b in Focus Financial Partners , valuing the wealth management firm at about $21b (including debt), per Bloomberg. Existing backers Clayton Dubilier & Rice and Stone Point Capital remain controlling shareholders. axios.link/4AA24U3 

 🚑 Bertram Capital invested in Medical Technology Associates , a Pinellas Park, Fla.-based provider of compliance services to healthcare and life sciences customers. axios.link/4kTPQRx 

 • Certerra , backed by OceanSound Partners , acquired TSFGeo , a West Palm Beach, Fla.-based consultancy for heavy civil infrastructure projects. axios.link/3VqK2om 

 • CVC Capital Partners abandoned its nearly €3b agreement to buy Irca , an Italian B2B manufacturer of ingredient solutions, from Advent International . The decision, to which Advent objected, could trigger a termination payment. axios.link/3Wy5ZCl 

 • KKR was picked as preferred bidder for Japanese curry rice restaurant chain Ichibanya , per Bloomberg. The deal could be valued at around $1.1b. axios.link/3WOtJCb 

 • Loftware , backed by Accel-KKR and RS2 Healthcare Partners , acquired Seagull Software , a Redmond, Wash.-based provider of supply chain traceability and labeling software, from Peak Rock Capital . axios.link/48Xk3YG 

 • Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan and CPP Investments agreed to join Nordic Capital as co-owners of Cary Group , a Stockholm-based provider of vehicle glass repair and replacement services. The two firms are buying out CVC Capital Partners at around a €3b valuation. axios.link/4jmJDMI 

 • Quirch Foods , backed by Palladium Equity Partners , acquired Mies Family Foods , a Kansas City-based food distributor. axios.link/4f9Nme8 

 🚑 Rosemont Pharmaceuticals , a U.K. drugmaker owned by Inflexion , agreed to acquire Denver-based Aytu BioPharma (Nasdaq: ATYU) for $56m in cash, or $2.70 per share (52% premium). axios.link/4AB1PrO 

 • Vista Equity Partners invested in TipHaus , a Seattle-based provider of tip management and tip operations software. axios.link/4zisyIB 

 • XKIG , backed by Sterling Investment Partners , acquired Jensen's Tree Service , a Roseburg, Ore.-based utility vegetation management company. axios.link/4AFxtVo 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Public Offerings 
 
 
   
 
 • Core Specialty Insurance , a Cincinnati-based P&C insurer backed by Aquiline , filed for an IPO that Renaissance Capital estimates could raise $250m. It plans to list on the NYSE (CORE). axios.link/4zMEsvp 

 🚑 vVardis , a Swiss dental products maker backed by Apollo and OrbiMed , raised $175m in its IPO. It priced 9.7m shares at $18, versus plans to offer 9.5m at $21-$24, and listed on the NYSE (VVVV). axios.link/48Gc7ek 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Liquidity Events 
 
 
   
 
 🚑 Credo Health , a VC-backed medical records platform, bought Affineon , which had been seeded by AI Fund, Benhamou Global Ventures, and Engine Health Capital. axios.link/3Vp5CcV 

 🚑 CSI Cos , owned by Recruit Holdings and Mitsui & Co. , agreed to acquire HCTec , a Nashville-based provider of healthcare IT managed services, from Claritas Capital and TruArc Partners . axios.link/4C7eWm4 

 🚑 Eli Lilly (NYSE: LLY) agreed to buy Calytrix Bio , a developer of antibodies for treating rare blood cancers, for up to $1.5b. Calytrix had raised from JPMorgan Life Sciences Private Capital, Westlake BioPartners, and Avoro Ventures. axios.link/4zTaSEK 

 🚑 Elligint Health , a VC-backed care and utilization management platform for health plans, acquired Laguna Health , an Israeli conversational AI platform for health plans that had raised $21m from HC9 Ventures, SemperVirens Venture Capital, and Mercer Ventures. axios.link/3WKHLEU 

 • KKR completed its sale of USI Insurance Services to Aon (NYSE: AON). axios.link/4iUL2c6 

 🚑 Medtronic (NYSE: MDT) acquired Contego Medical , a Raleigh, N.C.-based maker of carotid stents, for $380m. Contego had raised $68m from firms like USVP, Hatteras Venture Partners, and Bow River Capital. axios.link/4t1YEa2 

 ⚡️ Our Next Energy , a Novi, Mich.-based energy storage company that's raised $480m in VC funding, plans to go public at an implied $1b valuation via reverse merger with Wen Acquisition Corp . (Nasdaq: WENN), a SPAC led by Julian Sevillano (ex-McKinsey). axios.link/3WLkNgW 

 • PSP Capital completed its $530m sale of StormTrap , a Romeoville, Ill.-based provider of stormwater management systems, to Advanced Drainage Systems (NYSE: WMS). axios.link/3UTNsjl 

 • SAP (NYSE: SAP) completed its acquisition of TechWolf , a Belgian internal talent management platform that had raised $55m from SAP, Felix Capital, ServiceNow, Workday, Acadian Ventures, Fortino Capital Partners, Notion Capital, SemperVirens, and 20VC. axios.link/472UZyQ 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 More M&A 
 
 
   
 
 🚀 Iceye, a Finnish satellite observation provider valued by VCs at over €10b, offered to buy Italian rocket maker Avio (Milan: AVIO) for €2.05b, or €41 per share (20% premium to Monday's closing price). axios.link/4jhUffX 

 • KeyCorp (NYSE: KEY) agreed to acquire a stake in MMG , a Kansas City-based multifamily investment-sales and advisory firm. axios.link/4iX0Ivk 

 🚑 Gedeon Richter , a listed Hungarian drugmaker, agreed to buy Australia's Mayne Pharma (ASX: MYX) for around A$604m. axios.link/4t4F1hv 

 • Québecor (TSX: QBR) made an unsolicited C$31b cash-and-stock bid for larger rival Telus (TSX: T). axios.link/3WAaTib 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Fundraising 
 
 
   
 
 • Argonaut Private Equity , a Tulsa-based firm focused on investing in "Middle America," raised $606m for its sixth fund. argonautpe.com 

 • Starfire Ventures , co-led by Serena Williams, is seeking $200m for its debut fund to back AI-native startups. Williams' existing firm, Serena Ventures, will no longer write new checks. axios.link/3VvN22L 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 It's Personnel 
 
 
   
 
 • Francis Stapleton is joining Bank of America to lead activism defense, per Reuters. He previously was with Evercore. axios.link/4zjBRbf 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Final Numbers 
 
 
   
 
 Note: Survey of 20 market contacts in spring 2026 and 23 in fall 2026; Data: Federal Reserve ; Chart: Courtenay Brown/Axios Financial bets underpinning the AI boom are becoming far bigger and harder to untangle than soaring debt figures alone suggest, Axios' Courtenay Brown and Neil Irwin report .

 That is the new warning from the Federal Reserve, which, for the first time, devoted a section to AI financing in its latest assessment of financial stability. 
 
   
 
 🚑 Thanks for reading Axios Pro Rata , and to copy editor Bryan McBournie! Please ask your friends, colleagues, and Nvidia analysts to sign up .
